anim_format.format: header u8 n_rec,u8 n_img,u8 n_alpha,u8 has_pal,u32 delay_ms,u32 W,u32 H,u32 id; n_rec x 20-byte records; n_img WxH 8bpp images; n_alpha WxH 8-bit alpha maps; 768-byte palette if has_pal (4-bit, B,R,G order)
anim_format.playback: one record per tick of delay_ms (0x403014 waits [obj+0x20]); frame centred on the target point (x-W/2, y-H/2) (0x402cb5)

record.mode 1: alpha-map blend: alpha image = p2, strength = p3 (0..16) (0x430369 -> 0x4300c8)
record.mode 0: weighted blend: background weight p2, image weight p3 (0..16) via the RGB444 LUT (0x43030e -> 0x42fd5a); p2 == 0 -> plain copy of non-zero pixels; (16,16) ~ additive

strategy_effect_table.rule: v < 100: Xben entry v; 100 <= v < 200: MCALL(v-100) (0x4217fe uses v % 100) played full-screen; 255: none. For MCALL strategies 0x4215f0 also remaps the follow-up Xben effect via a jump table (values 1,3,5,7,0x16,0x39,0x0a or none)

xben.notes: entries 52..56 = 216x50 animated weather panels (0x44a121 loads entry 0x34 + weather id; static versions in Xthree.wa)

ranges_attack.role: attack-range diagrams (8x8 grid of 8px cells, blue = unit, red = reach); loaders 0x46fcb4/0x478164; index = class attack-range type (data.wa)

ranges_strategy.role: strategy effect-area diagrams (red = target, green = area); loader 0x46fdda; index = strategy area type (data.wa)

weather.role: battle weather panel: 0 clear, 1 cloudy, 2 rain, 3 heavy rain, 4 snow

map_patches.source: Nima.wa: 186 entries, 3x3 cells of 48x48 stored cell after cell (like HM)
map_patches.role: battle-map change overlays (gates, walls, bridges, fire...) drawn when a cell terrain changes (0x456140 writes the terrain grid then redraws); palette = the current map Fei palette, so idx/*.png keep raw palette indices (grey value = index) and the RGB preview uses the best-fitting map palette (heuristic)

items32.role: item pictures drawn by the game itself (same artwork as ItemIcon.dll large icons)

qusi.role: 0-2/9-11 small buttons, 3 400x296 and 4 400x128 blue dragon-pattern window backgrounds, 5-8 576x72 sea/shore panorama strips, 12-14 48-wide pieces with a 2-byte header (sizes guessed)

kao.source: Kao.wa: raw 116960-byte UI atlas read whole into buffer 0x4aeb50 (0x42ba29); sprites addressed by fixed byte offsets (push off / 0x47fa40) with sizes from the blit calls; region table partly inferred
